messages:
Jamal: FYI getting reports that enablement feedback submissions are creating playbook assignments to the wrong owner.
Renee: noticed a cluster of 'owner':null assignments in the last hour. Some accounts got auto-assigned to the default cs_pool.
Diego: any idea trigger? webhook or mapping change?
Jamal: preliminary — looks like the feedback webhook payload changed: `primary_owner -> lead_owner` and our mapping wasn't updated.
Sasha: ugh. that explains the healthscore bump on accounts with 0 owner. owners are required to get manual nudges.
Renee: impact: 230 feedback items mapped, ~90 accounts had owner cleared; 11 are in renewal window.
cs-bot: alert CREATED: ENABLEMENT_FEEDBACK_OWNER_MISMAP #3249876543 severity: high; linked: webhook-validators, playbook-assignments
Diego: plan: 1) patch mapping in ingestion lambda 2) backfill owner field for affected accounts using last_known_owner 3) resync playbook assignments 4) notify AMs for the 11 renewals.
Jamal: pausing feedback ingestion to prevent more noise. command: `ingest.pause(source=enablement-feedback)`
cs-bot: ingest.pause acknowledged by ops at 2025-04-12T14:12:05Z
Renee: backfill query ready: `select fid, account_id, last_known_owner from feedback where owner is null and created_at > '2025-04-12'` will update via batch job.
Diego: will open PR to accept both `primary_owner` and `lead_owner` keys during migration, add unit test.
Sasha: for the 11 renewals, can we also trigger a manual 'high-touch' playbook to ensure AMs are notified?
Jamal: yes, I'll queue a manual-run for those accounts after backfill.
Renee: running dry-run backfill in staging now. results: 230 rows would be updated, 11 accounts marked renewal=true.
cs-bot: staging job completed: dry-run OK.
Diego: PR merged with compatibility and validator that fails ingest if both keys missing. Also added a telemetry tag to record payload schema version.
Jamal: executing prod backfill job; job id fb-324987.
cs-bot: backfill job fb-324987 succeeded: 230 owners restored, 11 renewal accounts queued for high-touch playbook.
Sasha: AMs notified via DM template: "We detected missing owner on recent enablement feedback for <account>. We restored the previous owner and queued a high-touch check-in. Reply if you want us to pause outreach."
Renee: one AM replied concerned about message volume; marked that account to exclude from automated nudges for 48h.
Diego: follow-ups: 1) add schema contract test in CI for payload keys 2) add alert if owner_null_rate > 0.2% 3) add runbook for similar webhook drift. I'll take these.
Jamal: re-enabled ingestion: `ingest.resume(source=enablement-feedback)` — cs-bot confirmed.
cs-bot: ingest.resume succeeded at 2025-04-12T15:04:22Z
Sasha: adding postmortem draft to #customer-success-postmortems with timeline and outreach logs.
Renee: thanks team. small ask: can we include a note in the enablement integration docs about owner key name? saves future confusion.
Diego: will update docs. :memo:
Jamal: closing — metrics return to baseline, AMs acknowledged. :white_check_mark:
